# Then

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
If condition Then statement
```

## Description

Part of the one-line [If](If): the statements after `Then` run when the condition is true. It is left out in the block form of `If`.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
If 2 > 1 Then Print "yes"
If 2 < 1 Then Print "no" Else Print "else part"
```

```text
yes
else part
```

[If](If), [Select](Select)
